# Graph operations · motion

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### motion.landmarks

Sample tracked points and silhouettes as corresponding rest and posed landmarks.

Origin: toolkit.
Samples the graph clock.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `observations` | `array<record>` | Required | {"items":"record"} |
| Input | `bindings` | `array<record>` | Required | {"items":"record"} |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"time":{"type":"number","unit":"seconds"}} |
| Output | `value` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `landmarks` | `array<record>` | — | {"items":"record"} |

Guides: [guide](../headless-authoring.md#motion-driven-deformation)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe motion.landmarks --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.
